scope: WasmBench filtered v1.0, Wasmizer Figshare v2, WasmMal label CSVs, two MinerRay site CSVs, Industry2025 downloaded archive, and the complete downloaded MineSweeper crawled-site archive; not a claim about every metadata source on the Web

wasmbench.interpretation: No per-source observation date field found

wasmizer.interpretation: Collection interval is not a per-binary field observation or first appearance date

label_csvs.schema: filename, integer author label; no header
filename, integer author label; no header

wasmmal.interpretation: Label/split files provide no individual observation dates or verified mutation-parent dates

site_csvs.interpretation: Site-level context; no observation-date or binary-SHA column in inspected header
Site-level context; no observation-date or binary-SHA column in inspected header

minerray.interpretation: Named site samples are not hash-linked per-binary temporal measurements

industry2025.interpretation: Downloaded archive has binaries only; external urlscan/archive observations were not reconstructed and ZIP/7z modification times are not used as field observation dates

minesweeper.interpretation: Paper-supported corpus observation interval; no per-SHA first-seen date and no second comparable interval in this artifact

conclusion: MineSweeper supports one corpus-level March 2018 observation interval. The inspected metadata still cannot support an individual-binary temporal obfuscation trend or a cross-period trend. Publication/download dates are not used as attack dates.
